pages.heading: Crow
pages.body: Forests and plains. Wild crows damage crops; a carved pumpkin protects a small field. Toss Pumpkin Seeds to tame one. A tamed crow can gather items around a

pages.heading: Crow (cont.)
pages.body: hay-block home and deposit them into containers marked with a matching item frame. Hay heals resting crows. Sneak to remove shoulder riders.
